title: Qiushi Discovery Engine proposes and validates an optical bilinear interaction
summary: An LLM agent (Qiushi Discovery Engine) given only the topic optical computing for AI ran an open-ended study of 145.9 million tokens, 3,242 LLM calls and 1,242 tool calls, and proposed an optical bilinear interaction analogous to the attention operation in Transformers, which the authors say they experimentally validated. The abstract gives no accuracy figure or number of experimental runs. This is an arXiv preprint and the validation is reported by the authors themselves.
ai_technology: Qiushi Discovery Engine (dual-layer LLM agent with Meta-Trace memory)

evidence.tested: The abstract says the proposed optical bilinear interaction was experimentally validated on a real optical platform; it gives no measurement details, trial counts or statistics.
evidence.unknown: The abstract gives no validation figures and hedges novelty with 'to our knowledge'; hardware use is framed only as a possible route.
evidence.ai_role: An LLM-based agentic system (Qiushi Discovery Engine) ran an open-ended study (3,242 LLM calls, 1,242 tool calls, 163 research notes, 44 scripts) and proposed the mechanism.
